fitted_weight_surface.formula: causal applicability multiplied by 1/(1+predicted absolute error); available bases renormalize continuously
fitted_weight_surface.fit: ordinary least squares error~phase per basis x leg-state x pair-state, with every evaluated event subtracted from its own sufficient statistics
fitted_weight_surface.plain_language: Each causal basis keeps its receipt-level applicability. Leave-self-out training estimates that basis's absolute depth error as a continuous line over window phase for the current leg and pair states. The applicability is discounted by one over one plus that predicted error; all available bases then renormalize.
